# CANDIDATE: BACKTEST_PENDING_TRIGGER

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We propose to run the Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder to generate a set of strategy candidates, then
perform walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) to select a candidate
that captures edge on J's winner days while avoiding losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

The autoresearch grinder will test a grid of strategy parameters (to be defined in the grinder configuration) over
the historical SPY 5m data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using real OPRA fills. The top candidates by edge_capture
on the full sample will be selected for walk-forward OOS testing (using a held-out period) and then real-fills
validation on the top 3 J days. The candidate that passes the OOS and real-fills validation on the J days will be
proposed as a strategy.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (as per OP-20 disclosure 1).
2. **Sample bias:** The Stage-1 backtest will use the full available history (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) but may suffer from
   overfit risk due to the large parameter grid. We will use walk-forward OOS and real-fills on J days to mitigate.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will be performed after Stage-1 backtest as walk-forward on a held-out window).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will be performed on top 3 J days after OOS).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: unknown until backtest; max drawdown: unknown; blow-up scenario: unknown.
6. **Concentration:** unknown until backtest.

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
- Stage-1 backtest must complete without errors.
- Walk-forward OOS must show positive edge_capture and Sharpe ratio above a threshold (to be determined).
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show edge_capture contribution consistent with OOS.
- Gym validators (unit tests) must pass.
